title: PackageTreeVerification/v1 (CANDIDATE)
description: CANDIDATE server-side static-scan observation of a package tree under digest_domain sha256-tree-manifest-v1 (KCLIVE-03, KC-Brain comments 6707986144 and 6708734290). Not a download, not a readback, not a PrivateExactReadbackReceipt/v1, and not a PrivatePackageReadbackReceipt/v1. It claims neither delivery to a consumer nor a matched receipt. A record exists ONLY after a complete, stable scan; a partial, changing, budget-exceeded or otherwise refused scan, or a registry-pin refusal, emits NO record (the typed refusal travels in the enclosing operation detail) and never a fabricated root or count. outcome=refused is valid only when a complete stable scan established a concrete mismatch to the expected root. Without an independently trusted registry-byte digest and an authorised issuer/revision witness this is a claimed-row tree observation, not source admission or a verified authorised registry resolution; no release gate or corpus admission may accept it. runtime_authorized, knowledge_admitted and kc2_admission are constants; there is no published_corpus_admission field (publication/admission and consumer delivery are separate evidence events). Resource budgets are operational limits with typed refusals, not schema bounds. Field names inside resolution and the closed refusal_code set are CANDIDATE choices.

member_count.description: Mathematical integer > 0 from a completed non-empty scan; never rounded or capped (operational budgets are enforced separately).

size_bytes.description: Mathematical non-negative integer; never rounded or capped.

registry_ref.description: Opaque, NON-AUTHENTICATING label (for example LocationRegistry/v1@<label>). It does not pin or authenticate the registry bytes; that is the job of a separately versioned LocationRegistryPin/v1 envelope held outside this record.

runtime_authorized.description: Constant false in every emitted record.

knowledge_admitted.description: Constant false in every emitted record.

kc2_admission.description: Constant not_measured in every emitted record.
